Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphopenia, with monocytosis and basophilia. Total protein is slightly decreased. These findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible infection, or systemic inflammatory/hematologic disorder. Correlation with clinical context and further diagnostic workup are recommended.
